ProxyVersionUpgradeOrRestart.proxyList: Empty for upgrade tasks; required for restart tasks. Enter the showIds of proxies to restart in batch
ProxyVersionUpgradeOrRestart.upgradeType: Task type. `relaunch`: restart proxy; `latest`: upgrade proxy version
ProxyVersionUpgradeOrRestart.isDefer: Whether to defer execution, default false. `false`: execute immediately; `true`: execute during maintenance time window
